articles.title: Garpenberg Seismic Halt Tests Boliden Production Reliability And Earnings Story
articles.summary: Abnormal seismic activity at Boliden's Garpenberg mine triggered a full evacuation and production halt. Both mining and concentrator operations are currently stopped pending inspections and safety checks. The company has not provided a timeline for when operations may resume or how quickly production could ramp back up.
